module: Feeds the UI's task list (SetTasklistHeader and SetTasklistTask events) for the crash test scenario. Each step becomes a 'goal'-type task identified by the player vehicle's id (plVehId); label and subtext are built from the objective, the impact speed and the damage conditions. The hooks mark the task as active, failed or completed.
notes: The task id is stepData.plVehId: if several steps have the same player vehicle, they share the same id on the UI side.
Label: 'Simple crash' -> "Crash into the marked target(s)"; 'Crash target vehicle into target area' -> "Redirect the target into the highlighted area"; other objective -> nil.

Subtext: impact speed converted by translateVelocity (player's unit), followed by the damage text ("Minimize damage", "Maximize damage", "At least X damage", "Not more than X damage"). No space is inserted between the speed and the damage text.
resetTasklist is defined but never called nor exported.
clearTasklist and reset crash if setCrashTestDataAndInit has not been called (crashTestData nil).

setCrashTestDataAndInit.desc: Stores the step list, displays the "Crash analysis steps" header and creates the first task (inactive).

crashTestData_.desc: List of the crash test's step data.

onNewCrashTestStep.desc: Hook called at the start of a step: sends the corresponding task as active (neither completed nor failed).

onCrashTestStepFailed.desc: Hook called when a step fails: marks the task as failed (fail = true). No effect if stepData is nil.

finishedCurrentTask.desc: Marks the step's task as completed (done = true).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension unloads: removes all tasks from the UI.

reset.desc: Removes all tasks from the UI (clear = true for each step).
